identifiers.causal_driver: Somatic JAK2 p.Val617Phe (JH2 pseudokinase domain, ~50-60%), CALR (~25-30%), or MPL (~5-10%)

epidemiology.us_incidence: 1.0 - 1.56 per 100,000 person-years (~3,500 - 5,000 new US cases/year including PMF and post-PV/ET MF)
epidemiology.us_prevalence_estimate: 15,000 - 25,000+ living patients in the US (~4-6 per 100,000; well under the 200,000 FDA Orphan Drug ceiling)
epidemiology.jak2_v617f_driver_share: ~50% - 60% of Primary Myelofibrosis (PMF) and post-ET MF; >95% of Post-Polycythemia Vera MF
epidemiology.other_drivers: CALR exon 9 indels (~20-35%, surface-targetable via mAb INCA033989), MPL W515L/K (~5-8%), Triple-Negative (~10%), plus HMR co-mutations (ASXL1, SRSF2, U2AF1, EZH2, IDH1/2, TP53)
epidemiology.median_survival: ~5-7 years overall from diagnosis; drops to 11-23 months following ruxolitinib discontinuation (3-4 months upon blast-phase AML transformation).

biological_tractability.causal_mechanism: A somatic point mutation (G1849T -> Val617Phe) in exon 14 encoding the JH2 pseudokinase domain of JAK2 disrupts autoinhibition of the JH1 catalytic kinase domain, driving constitutive cytokine-independent STAT3/STAT5, MAPK, and PI3K/AKT signaling via EPOR, MPL, and GCSFR.
why_highly_tractable_now: Validated JH2 Allosteric Pocket: High-resolution crystal structures of V617F JH2 (PDB: 4FVR, 6E2Q, 8BAK, 8EX2) vs WT JH2 (PDB: 4FVP) enable selective small molecules/PROTACs sparing WT JAK2, with first-in-class clinical entrants INCB160058 (NCT06313593) and Type II binder AJ1-11095 (NCT06343805) de-risking the biology.

Intracellular Engineering Imperative: Unlike mutant CALR (which traffics to the cell surface and responds to mAb INCA033989, NCT06034002), JAK2 V617F is strictly intracellular—demanding JH2 small molecules, PROTAC degraders, or TCR-mimetics.

Quantitative Blood Clonal Biomarker: Peripheral blood ddPCR/NGS directly measures JAK2 V617F Variant Allele Frequency (VAF), enabling rapid Phase 1b pharmacodynamic readouts of true stem-cell clearance.

2024-2026 Late-Stage Pipeline Reset: Discontinuations of navitoclax (TRANSFORM-1, NCT04472598) and imetelstat (IMpactMF, NCT04576156, Oct 2026 OS futility) plus SVR35/TSS50 discordance in MANIFEST-2 (pelabresib) and SENTRY (selinexor, which showed a June 2026 >50% OS hazard reduction signal alongside BOREAS/POIESIS navtemadlin and Fast-Track PIM1 inhibitor nuvisertib TP-3654) prove the urgent market need for non-myelosuppressive clonal & antifibrotic therapies and modernized digital endpoints.
biological_tractability.fibrotic_microenvironment: Clonal JAK2 V617F megakaryocytes secrete S100A8/A9 alarmins, TGF-beta1/3, CXCL4, PDGF, and IL-1b/IL-6 that reprogram LepR+/GLI1+ mesenchymal stromal cells into collagen-depositing myofibroblasts, destroying marrow hematopoiesis.

approved_therapies: Ruxolitinib (Jakafi, Nov 2011; Jakafi XR once-daily approved May 1, 2026; COMFORT-I/II NCT00952289/NCT00934544) - Type I JH1 JAK1/JAK2 inhibitor
Fedratinib (Inrebic, Aug 2019; JAKARTA NCT01437787) - Type I JH1 JAK2/FLT3 inhibitor (carries Wernicke encephalopathy Boxed Warning)
Pacritinib (Vonjo, Feb 2022 Accelerated Approval; PERSIST-2 NCT02055781) - Type I JH1 JAK2/IRAK1/ACVR1 inhibitor for severe thrombocytopenia (platelets <50x10^9/L)
Momelotinib (Ojjaara, Sept 2023; MOMENTUM NCT04173494) - Type I JH1 JAK1/JAK2/ACVR1 inhibitor improving anemia via hepcidin suppression
core_failure_mechanisms: Zero WT vs Mutant Selectivity: JH1 ATP sites are identical in WT and V617F JAK2; blocking WT JAK2 suppresses EPOR/TPOR signaling, causing dose-limiting iatrogenic anemia and thrombocytopenia.

Type I Heterodimer Persistence & Clonal Evolution: Chronic Type I inhibition stabilizes hyperphosphorylated JAK2 that trans-activates via JAK1/TYK2, allowing malignant HSCs to persist and acquire ASXL1, RAS, or multi-hit TP53 mutations without reversing marrow fibrosis.
The Ruxolitinib Discontinuation Cliff: ~50% of patients stop ruxolitinib within 3 years (~70-75% by 5 years), facing 11-23 months median OS.
Allo-HSCT Bottleneck: Curative transplant reaches <10-15% of eligible patients due to median diagnosis age 65-70, 20-36% non-relapse mortality (NRM), and 15-30% relapse.

fda_orphan_drug_act: 100% waiver of FDA PDUFA clinical NDA/BLA filing fee ($4,682,003 cash savings in FY2026)
7 years of statutory US market exclusivity upon approval (10 years in EU via EMA Orphan designation)
25% federal Orphan Drug Tax Credit (ODTC) on qualified clinical testing expenses
Eligibility for FDA OOPD Orphan Products Clinical Trials Grants ($250K-$750K/yr for up to 4 years) & FDA RDEA composite endpoint pilot
regulatory_and_commercial_incentives.trial_efficiency: Registration-directed MF trials typically enroll N=120-350 patients (vs N=1,000+ in common oncology/cardiology), with active regulatory momentum toward composite VAF + marrow fibrosis + ePRO surrogates.
regulatory_and_commercial_incentives.commercial_precedents: Multi-billion-dollar category (*Jakafi* >$4.5B/yr global franchise) with three recent single-asset MF acquisitions between $1.7B and $2.9B (CTI BioPharma -> Sobi $1.7B; Sierra Oncology -> GSK $1.9B; MorphoSys -> Novartis $2.9B).

name: Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF — Primary & Lupus/SLE-Associated) & The Dual Iron-Hepcidin Axis

key_literature: Pullarkat et al., Am J Hematol 2003 (Primary AIMF criteria)
Vergara-Lluri et al., Hum Pathol 2014 (Morphometric separation from PMF)
Mertz et al., Haematologica 2021 (French multicenter cohort, n=30)
Gangat, Reichard, Orazi & Tefferi, Br J Haematol 2024 (Mayo Clinic cohort, n=22)
identifiers.causal_driver: Polyclonal T/B-cell autoimmune cytokine-driven marrow reticulin fibrosis (100% negative for JAK2/CALR/MPL/HMR clonal drivers) + dual transfusional & IL-6/hepcidin iron overload

epidemiology.demographics: Median age 37-45 years (vs 65-70 in clonal PMF); strong ~75-80% female predominance.
epidemiology.autoimmune_associations: Secondary AIMF (~80%+): Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE, ~50-60%), Sjogren's (~10-15%), Evans syndrome / Coombs+ AIHA, UCTD. Primary AIMF: ANA+/DAT+/autoantibody+ without meeting full ACR SLE criteria.
epidemiology.driver_mutation_status: 100% negative for JAK2 V617F, CALR, and MPL, AND negative for clonal myeloid HMR mutations (ASXL1, SRSF2, U2AF1, EZH2, TET2, TP53) with normal diploid karyotype.
epidemiology.us_prevalence: Under-recognized benign mimic accounting for a critical curable fraction of 'triple-negative' myelofibrosis & SLE cytopenias
epidemiology.median_survival: Favorable (74-80% hematologic & fibrosis remission on steroids/rituximab when rescued from misdiagnosis)

biological_tractability.causal_mechanism: Immune-mediated polyclonal T/B-cell infiltration and autoimmune cytokine release (IL-6, IL-1b, IFN-g, TGF-b) irritate normal bone marrow stroma into depositing MF-1 to MF-3 reticulin fibers without neoplastic stem-cell transformation.
dual_iron_overload_mechanism: 1. Transfusional Hemosiderosis: 59% of AIMF patients require chronic PRBC transfusions (Mayo 2024); 10-20 units add 2.5-5.0g of non-excretable iron, saturating transferrin (TSAT >50-80%) and generating labile plasma iron (LPI) oxidative marrow toxicity (responsive to deferasirox chelation).

2. Inflammatory IL-6 -> Hepcidin Blockade: Autoimmune IL-6 hyper-activates hepatic STAT3 -> hepcidin, degrading ferroportin (SLC40A1) and locking recycled iron inside marrow macrophages (3-4+ Prussian blue hemosiderin, ferritin >1,000-10,000 ng/mL) while starving erythropoiesis.
biological_tractability.why_invaluable_for_builders: 74% overall Complete Response (CR) rate on immunosuppression and 80% CR on rituximab salvage (Gangat et al. 2024), with objective histological regression of marrow fibrosis in 3-12 months—serving as 'Nature's Positive Control' proving human marrow fibrosis is biologically reversible.

core_failure_mechanisms: Catastrophic Misdiagnosis as Triple-Negative PMF: 30-40% community pathology discordance leads to AIMF patients receiving cytopenic $20K/mo JAK inhibitors (worsening anemia!) or 20-35% mortality stem cell transplants instead of curative steroids/rituximab/mycophenolate.
Rheumatology-Hematology Silo: Lupus/UCTD clinics rarely biopsy marrow, while hematology clinics under-order autoimmune panels and misread dual transfusional + hepcidin-trapped hyperferritinemia.

name: VEXAS Syndrome (Somatic UBA1 X-Linked Myeloid Autoinflammation & Marrow Failure)

identifiers.causal_driver: Somatic UBA1 p.Met41Thr/Val/Leu & splice-site mutations in hematopoietic stem cells (loss of cytoplasmic UBA1b -> catalytically impaired UBA1c)
key_literature: Beck et al., NEJM 2020 (Discovery of VEXAS somatic UBA1 syndrome)
Beck et al., JAMA 2023 (1 in 4,269 prevalence in men >50 across Geisinger health system)
Wu et al., Blood / Nat Med 2023-2024 (Single-cell bone marrow multi-omics GSE163683)
Patel et al., Blood 2024 (Allogeneic HSCT & clonal dynamics NCT05027945)

epidemiology.us_prevalence: ~15,000+ US adults (~1 in 4,269 men >50 yrs; ~1 in 26,238 women >50 yrs via X-monosomy/skewing)
epidemiology.demographics: Median onset 64-68 years; >95% male due to X-linked UBA1 locus.
epidemiology.median_survival: ~50-63% 5-year survival overall; p.Met41Val genotype and transfusion dependence carry highest mortality.

biological_tractability.causal_mechanism: Single somatic codon hotspot (Met41) in the master E1 ubiquitin-activating enzyme UBA1 ablates translation of cytoplasmic isoform UBA1b and shifts initiation to Met67 (UBA1c), starving myeloid progenitors of ubiquitylation, triggering PERK/IRE1a unfolded-protein response, cytoplasmic vacuoles, macrocytic anemia, and NLRP3/IL-1/IL-6/TNF/IFN cytokine storms.
biological_tractability.why_invaluable_for_builders: Monogenic somatic etiology (like JAK2 V617F!) with Primary Myelofibrosis-scale US prevalence (~15,000+), zero FDA-approved therapies, massive >80% underdiagnosis in routine EHRs (MCV >100 fL + CRP), and rich public single-cell bone marrow datasets (GSE163683).

core_failure_mechanisms: Zero FDA-Approved Drugs & Steroid Toxicity Trap: Most patients require >=20 mg/day prednisone to suppress fevers/chondritis/vasculitis, suffering severe opportunistic infections, thrombosis (~40%), and progressive cytopenias.

Cytokine Palliatives Leave UBA1 Clones Intact: Ruxolitinib, pacritinib (PAXIS NCT06538181), tocilizumab, and azacitidine reduce inflammation in subsets, but non-clonal-eradicating palliatives allow UBA1 VAF expansion toward MDS/transfusion failure.

open_data_infrastructure.description: Single-cell RNA-seq, CITE-seq, and somatic UBA1 genotyping of VEXAS HSPCs and myeloid lineages.
High-resolution crystal structure of human ubiquitin-activating enzyme UBA1 for pocket and stabilizer modeling.
Randomized PAXIS pacritinib trial (NCT06538181) and NIH Phase 2 allogeneic HSCT study (NCT05027945).

name: Idiopathic Multicentric Castleman Disease (iMCD & iMCD-TAFRO — IL-6 / mTOR / JAK-STAT Cytokine Storm)

identifiers.causal_driver: HHV-8-negative polyclonal/oligoclonal lymphoproliferative cytokine storm driven by IL-6, VEGF, PI3K/Akt/mTOR, and JAK-STAT1/3 hyperactivation
key_literature: Fajgenbaum et al., Blood 2017 (International consensus diagnostic criteria for iMCD)
Fajgenbaum et al., J Clin Invest 2019 (mTOR activation & sirolimus clinical remission in siltuximab-refractory iMCD)
Pierson et al., Blood Advances 2021-2024 (Proteomic endotypes & JAK-STAT activation in siltuximab non-responders)

epidemiology.us_prevalence: ~4,300-5,200 new US Castleman cases/yr (~1,500-2,000 iMCD); ~35% 5-year mortality historically in severe refractory cohorts
epidemiology.demographics: Affects children and adults (median age 35-50); iMCD-TAFRO subtype presents with acute thrombocytopenia, anasarca, fever, reticulin myelofibrosis, and organomegaly.
epidemiology.median_survival: Dramatically improved in siltuximab responders, but 60-66% fail anti-IL-6 monotherapy and face recurrent ICU multiorgan flares.

biological_tractability.causal_mechanism: Dysregulated stromal/myeloid/T-cell signaling drives systemic IL-6, VEGF, CXCL13, and mTORC1/JAK-STAT cascades—producing characteristic lymph-node germinal-center regression, hypervascularity, and reversible bone marrow reticulin fibrosis (TAFRO) closely mirroring Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF).
biological_tractability.why_invaluable_for_builders: Global poster child for AI-driven drug repurposing (Every Cure's origin story: sirolimus NCT03933904 & JAK1/2 inhibition rescuing siltuximab-refractory patients), backed by a world-class patient-led biobank & registry (CDCN ACCELERATE).

core_failure_mechanisms: Two-Thirds Siltuximab Non-Response Cliff: Only 34% of trial patients achieved durable tumor + symptomatic response on siltuximab, leaving 66% reliant on toxic multi-agent lymphoma chemotherapy or trial-and-error off-label salvage.
ICU Misdiagnosis of iMCD-TAFRO: Reticulin marrow fibrosis + severe thrombocytopenia + anasarca mimics SLE/AIMF, TTP, or lymphoma, delaying life-saving targeted blockade.

name: Systemic Mastocytosis (Indolent & Advanced SM — Clonal KIT D816V Kinase & Mast-Cell Mediator Syndrome)

identifiers.causal_driver: Somatic KIT p.Asp816Val (D816V) activation-loop gain-of-function mutation (>90-95% of adult SM) +/- concurrent SRSF2/ASXL1/RUNX1 (S/A/R) in Advanced SM
key_literature: Gotlib et al., NEJM / Nat Med 2021 (Avapritinib EXPLORER/PATHFINDER in Advanced SM)
Castells et al., NEJM Evid / JACI 2023 (PIONEER NCT03731260 low-dose avapritinib in Indolent SM)
Lyons et al., Nat Genet 2016 / JACI 2022 (TPSAB1 copy-number Hereditary Alpha-Tryptasemia overlap)

epidemiology.us_prevalence: ~30,000-35,000+ US patients (~85-90% Indolent/Smoldering SM; ~10-15% Advanced SM including SM-AHN frequently co-occurring with JAK2/CMML myeloid neoplasms!)
epidemiology.demographics: Adult onset (median age 45-60); SM-AHN (SM with Associated Hematologic Neoplasm) bridges directly to MPN/Myelofibrosis.
epidemiology.median_survival: Near-normal life expectancy in Indolent SM (with severe anaphylaxis/osteoporosis/GI morbidity), vs 2-4 years in Advanced SM-AHN / Mast Cell Leukemia.

biological_tractability.causal_mechanism: Single point mutation KIT D816V locks the receptor tyrosine kinase activation loop in a constitutively active conformation resistant to Type II imatinib, driving neoplastic mast-cell accumulation in marrow/skin/GI and explosive tryptase, histamine, PGD2, and leukotriene release.
biological_tractability.why_invaluable_for_builders: Proven >$9B orphan franchise category (avapritinib, bezuclastinib SUMMIT NCT05186753, elenestinib HARBOR NCT04910685) with clear chemistry differentiation (CNS exclusion Kp,uu <0.02 + WT-KIT/PDGFRa sparing) AND a massive 6-8 year diagnostic gap solvable via ultra-sensitive peripheral ddPCR + TPSAB1 triage.

core_failure_mechanisms: Blood-Brain Barrier & PDGFRa Off-Target Liability: First-gen D816V kinase inhibition carries cognitive adverse events and intracranial bleed contraindications at higher doses.

6-to-8 Year Diagnostic Odyssey & False-Negative Blood NGS: Standard 1-2% VAF clinic NGS misses peripheral KIT D816V (requiring <=0.01% ddPCR), while ungenotyped TPSAB1 copy-number elevation confounds basal tryptase interpretation.

open_data_infrastructure.description: Crystal structures of active and autoinhibited human KIT kinase domains for D816V selectivity and efflux modeling.

name: Dyskeratosis Congenita & Telomere Biology Disorders (TBD — TERT / TERC / DKC1 / PARN Stem-Cell Exhaustion)

identifiers.causal_driver: Pathogenic germline variants across >=17 telomere maintenance genes (TERT, TERC, DKC1, RTEL1, PARN, TINF2, ACD, CTC1, ZCCHC8, NAF1) shortening telomeres <1st age-adjusted percentile
key_literature: Townsley et al., NEJM 2016 (Danazol telomere elongation trial NCT01441037)
Nagpal et al., Nature / Blood 2020 (Small-molecule PAPD5 inhibition restores TERC RNA & telomeres in human TBD stem cells)
Ghanim et al., Cryo-EM Human Telomerase Holoenzyme PDB:7BG9
Agarwal et al., J Clin Oncol 2023 (Radiation- and alkylator-free HSCT NCT01659606)

epidemiology.us_prevalence: ~10,000-25,000+ US patients across pediatric classic Dyskeratosis Congenita and adult-onset cryptic TBD (accounting for ~15-25% of familial pulmonary fibrosis and ~5-10% of 'idiopathic' aplastic anemia/MDS)
epidemiology.demographics: Bimodal: childhood marrow failure (PRV-eligible Rare Pediatric Disease!) and 40-65 yr adult cryptic pulmonary/hepatic/marrow presentation with genetic anticipation across generations.
epidemiology.median_survival: Classic pediatric DC median survival ~30-40 yrs without non-myeloablative HSCT; adultTBD-IPF median post-diagnosis survival 3-5 yrs.

biological_tractability.causal_mechanism: Defective telomerase RNA biogenesis/stability (DKC1, PARN, ZCCHC8, NAF1, TERC) or catalytic reverse transcription (TERT) causes premature replicative senescence of hematopoietic, alveolar type II, and hepatic stem cells. Crucially, inhibiting non-canonical poly(A) polymerase PAPD5 (TENT4B) prevents exosome degradation of TERC, restoring endogenous telomerase activity without exogenous viral gene delivery.
biological_tractability.why_invaluable_for_builders: Unlocks a $100M-$158M FDA Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher (PRV) via pediatric Dyskeratosis Congenita while de-risking expansion into tens of thousands of adult telomere-driven pulmonary fibrosis and marrow failure patients!

core_failure_mechanisms: Zero Approved Disease-Modifying Drugs & Androgen Toxicity: Off-label danazol/oxymetholone causes hepatotoxicity, peliosis, lipid disorders, and virilization.

Fatal Iatrogenic Transplant Conditioning in Cryptic Adult TBD: Unrecognized adult TBD patients given standard busulfan/cyclophosphamide HSCT conditioning or IPF cytotoxic immunosuppression suffer catastrophic fatal organ toxicity—preventable by pre-conditioning Flow-FISH + alkylator-free protocols (NCT01659606).

open_data_infrastructure.description: Atomic cryo-EM architecture of human TERT-TERC-dyskerin H/ACA ribonucleoprotein complex.
NIH danazol study (NCT01441037) and radiation/alkylator-free BMT protocol (NCT01659606).
